name: PolarBlock breathable membrane
covers: Put on the outside face of each exterior OSB sheet at the shop, before the sheet goes on the CNC: it is cut out with the panel. Not on the steel frame, floors, roof or the pod-to-pod joints.
note: Print scale assumed: the dashed lines 12″ apart (the picture 48″ wide). Roll sizes (membrane and tape) to confirm.

tape.name: PolarBlock seam tape
